```{python}
import pandas as pd, openpyxl

df_full = pd.read_csv('lex_ref_link.csv', low_memory=False)
df_null = pd.read_excel("null_reflexes_with_ls.xlsx")
df_full['lex_ref_link_id'] = df_full['lex_ref_link_id'].astype(int)


# filtered = lex_ref[lex_ref["lex_ref_link_id"].isin(null["lex_ref_link_id"])]
# merged = lex_ref.merge(null[["lex_ref_link_id"]], on="lex_ref_link_id", how="inner")

# Filter df_full to only those IDs that are in df_null
filtered_full = df_full[df_full["lex_ref_link_id"].isin(df_null["lex_ref_link_id"])]

# Merge the two datasets (inner join) to bring gloss_orig into df_null
merged = pd.merge(
    df_null,
    filtered_full[["lex_ref_link_id", "gloss_orig"]],
    on="lex_ref_link_id",
    how="left"
)

# Keep only desired columns (if you want to enforce column order)
merged = merged[["lex_ref_link_id", "match_str", "ls_lemma", "comments", "checked", "gloss_orig"]]

# Save results
merged.to_excel("null_reflexes_with_gloss.xlsx", index=False)
```
